title: How to organize the automotive care zone | Garage
description:
Keeps the fluids, cables, and cleaning kit for the cars you actually own upright, labelled, and separate from everything the household touches.

This is the Automotive Care Zone in the Garage. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Every fluid bottle standing upright on a clean drip tray with its opened date written on the shoulder, jumper cables and tyre gauge together in one bag by the door, rags in a closed metal can, and not a single bottle for a car nobody here drives.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Line every bottle up and read the label out loud.
Straighten: Fluids stand upright on a shallow drip tray at waist height, where a weeping cap shows as a ring rather than s
Shine: Wipe every bottle shoulder and check the tray for the ring that says something is seeping.
Safety: Petrol and any can that has ever held it stays out of the house envelope, capped tight, and never on a shelf n
Standardize: Label the tray shelf with exactly what belongs on it, and mark every bottle with the month you opened it.
Sustain: You already lift the bonnet to check the oil.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every fluid stands upright on the tray, wears an opened date, and belongs to a car on this driveway.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/garage-the-automotive-care-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
